I built the landing page as `index.html` in the project folder, next to `images/`. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

The source is a magazine-style blog homepage, so I built it as one:

- **Top of page:** a dark bar with the category links and a "Trending" item, then the logo, site name and tagline. A sticky navigation bar follows.
- **Featured section:** the EPA story as the lead article, with three recent posts beside it.
- **Content sections:** Educations, College and University, Online Education, General, Skills & Certification, and Science. Science is full width and uses the wide 720×380 images.
- **Sidebar:** search, author (James E. Turner), latest posts and categories.
- **Footer:** quick links, top categories and the theme credit.

The page uses all of the images except `9-50x50.jpg`, which is a tiny trending thumbnail. It follows the system light or dark setting and works at phone width. All the text and links come from `copy.md`.

- **Search:** the box is cosmetic and doesn't search anything.
- **Posts without images:** several General and Skills posts have none in `images/`, so they appear as text cards.
- **Article text:** I left the wording exactly as in `copy.md`, including its odd phrases like "Trump Declares Decide to Lead…". Those look machine-spun, so you may want to edit them.
- **Image alt text:** most images have empty `alt` text because `copy.md` didn't provide any.
